question: Let $S$ be the set of all numbers of the form $4^n-3n-1$, where $n=1,2,3,\ldots$. Let $T$ be the set of all numbers of the form $9(n-1)$, where $n=1,2,3,\ldots$. Only one of the following statements is correct. Which one is it?

options.A: Each number in $S$ is also in $T.
options.B: Each number in $T$ is also in $S.
options.C: Every number in $S$ and every number in $T$ is in $S.
options.D: There are numbers in $S$ which are not in $T$ and there are numbers in $T$ which are not in $S.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
